title: Spain expels the Jews (Alhambra Decree)

points: The Jews of Spain who fled into Portugal were overcharged, ill-treated and their wives and daughters ravished by the ships' captains; the Castilian Jews who had not left in time were ordered taken as slaves and distributed to whoever asked for them.

source.title: Prophecy Fulfilled In The Midst Of War

needs: A documented source read on the Alhambra Decree (31 March 1492) and on the enslavement of Castilian Jews who entered Portugal under John II.

title: Brazil, the largest destination of the trade
summary: Brazil received captives above all from Kongo and Angola and abolished slavery only in the 1880s (as said in class; not yet sourced).

points: The slaves recruited for Brazil in the 19th century came almost entirely from the lower Congo and Dahomey.

needs: Moment seen only as a search hit; read it and a documented source (e.g. SlaveVoyages). Brazil’s abolition (1888) falls outside this period and belongs to the next.

title: Zumbi and the quilombo of Palmares
summary: Zumbi, born in Kongo, enslaved and shipped to Brazil, escaped and led the quilombo of Palmares, a settlement of escaped Africans (as read in a promotional clip).

points: King Zumbi dos Palmares, a prince of the kingdom of Kongo, was captured as a child, shipped to Brazil as a slave, escaped and led Palmares in resistance: the king who came over with the Israelites from Africa.

needs: The moment is a book advertisement played in class (no date for the recording); find a class moment that teaches Palmares and read a documented source; the years here are not yet sourced.

points: Sir Jeffery Amherst wrote a letter on using smallpox blankets as a weapon against the Native Americans: the curses of disease applied to the northern kingdom.
